scripts.build: npm run version-info && nx build && npx tsc --ignoreConfig src/background.ts --types chrome --outDir dist/bookmarks/browser --target es2022 --module es2022 --moduleResolution bundler && npm run verify:extension
scripts.test: umask 0002 && nx test --watch=false && npx playwright test
scripts.postinstall: npx playwright install && npm run version-info
scripts.build:dev: npm run version-info && nx run-many --target=build --all --configuration development --parallel 5 && npx tsc --ignoreConfig src/background.ts --types chrome --outDir dist/bookmarks/browser --target es2022 --module es2022 --moduleResolution bundler && npm run verify:extension
scripts.build:prod: npm run version-info && nx run-many --target=build --all --configuration production --parallel 5 && npx tsc --ignoreConfig src/background.ts --types chrome --outDir dist/bookmarks/browser --target es2022 --module es2022 --moduleResolution bundler && npm run verify:extension
